race.description: Country Music Raceday On Sale Now Qtis 3YO Hcp
race.comment: ESHA (1) looked like being anything when she bolted in at Moonee Valley early in her three-year-old season. Thrown in against older horses at WFA at start three and wasn't the same after that. Trialling well for new trainer Tony Gollan - this reset might be just what she needs. GET READY LASS (2) raced up on the pace but ran out of condition close to home when resuming over 1000m at the Sunshine Coast last start, a race won by NATURALLY LIT. Sure to take a lot from that hit-out so expect much more resistance this time. FORGOTTEN SPIRIT (3) is back after a 19-week spell. Raced well against some smart three-year-olds last prep. Two recent trials should have her right up to the mark. NATURALLY LIT (6) came from last in a big field for a stunning win in a $200k feature over this trip at the Sunshine Coast last start. Hard to hold out of she can repeat that effort. RACKETEER (10) finished just behind NATURALLY LIT at the Sunny Coast. Lightly raced and in the mix again.
